name: Abir Tasrif
headline: Textile Engineer × Tech Enthusiast
bio: I am a textile engineer turned tech enthusiast with deep expertise in industrial engineering, garment technology, and 3D fashion design. Over the years, I've worked across production floors, pattern rooms, and design studios — optimizing apparel manufacturing processes, creating technical packs, and building 3D garment simulations. Today, I combine that domain knowledge with modern web technologies to build software that solves real problems for the textile and apparel industry.
education: B.Sc. in Textile Engineering, Specialization in Apparel Manufacturing Technology

journey.title: Textile Engineering
journey.description: Studied fabric manufacturing, textile chemistry, apparel production, and quality engineering. Built a strong foundation in fiber-to-garment workflows.

journey.title: Industrial Engineering
journey.description: Worked in apparel manufacturing as an IE executive — conducting SMV studies, balancing production lines, improving operator efficiency, and implementing lean tools.

journey.title: Garment Technology
journey.description: Led technical packages, garment construction, sewing feasibility reviews, and defect root-cause analysis for high-volume export orders.

journey.title: 3D Fashion Design
journey.description: Mastered CLO 3D and Lectra Modaris for virtual sampling, 3D garment visualization, pattern grading, and fit simulation to reduce physical sample lead time.

journey.title: Web Development
journey.description: Transitioned into web engineering, building modern UIs with Next.js and JavaScript. Creating tools, portfolios, and learning content that blend textile domain knowledge with software craft.

experience.description: Design and develop modern web interfaces, dashboards, and marketing sites using Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS. Focus on performance, accessibility, and clean component architecture.
Optimized production lines, created detailed tech packs, conducted quality audits, and introduced 3D virtual prototyping into the product development cycle.
